evidence.exact_quote: At least 68 people have been killed after two passenger trains collided in Toledro province in central Spain, and the death toll may rise further
Spain’s prime minister Pedro Sánchez said the country was “in mourning” as he insisted the government will get to the bottom of incident and address potential failures with “utmost firmness
Transport minister Óscar Puente said initial review of the evidence pointed to an “inexplicable” decision to order trains to go ahead after a signalling failure, implying a human error
Both main parties suspended their campaigning activities ahead of next month’s parliamentary election, but the far-right Vox party continued with its rallies

framing_claims.text: El medio presenta el accidente como una tragedia de gran magnitud, resaltando el número de muertos y la respuesta del gobierno, al tiempo que señala la continuidad de la campaña de Vox pese al luto nacional
